effect_description_eng: [Main] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks." until their turn ends. Then, place this card in the battle area. [All Turns] When any of your Digimon with [Craniamon] in their names suspend, ＜Delay＞. ・＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete all of their Digimon with the lowest play cost.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest play cost. Then, add this card to the hand.
